discretization: Interpolate log mole fractions linearly, normalize the geometric path, integrate the local molar-frame mobility driven by the fixed entropy-variable jump using Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Numerical path definition is this project's finite-face choice; it is not claimed to be an exact steady profile or a source-measured pore law.
physical_input_classification: Same-temperature, same-pressure ideal free gas; arbitrary specified distance and endpoint compositions for numerical qualification.
